extracted.name: Peas with Mushrooms
extracted.description: Green peas are sauteed with mushrooms onion and garlic in this quick side dish. These will go well with steak or fish.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen green peas, thawed
instruction_lines: Cook peas according to package directions. Set aside.

Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Saute onion and garlic in butter until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in the peas and mushrooms, then season with sugar, salt, thyme and pepper. Reduce heat to low, and cook just until heated through.
